note: Generic gear price = a * stat^b, a power law fitted by least squares in log-log space to the library's own listed prices of that type (src/data/gearCatalog.ts, estimated prices excluded). `use` is true only where n >= 7 and r2 >= 0.7: there the curve replaces the hand-set demand-items.json price row's mode (its lo / hi keep the row's proportions); elsewhere the row stays. test/gearpricecurves.test.ts refits the library and fails when a curve drifts, so regenerate (see HANDOFF lane GM6) after the library changes.
